scene_description: A young boy sits on green grass leaning against a large tree trunk. He is wearing a blue hoodie and blue sneakers. Two American flags are visible — one large one nearby and a smaller one in the background. There is a sidewalk and a road behind him, with trees and a flower bush in the background.
